alignment.prediction_cutoff: c is an exact UTC hour. Every predictor report or interpreted source interval must end no later than c.
alignment.target_reference: t = c + 1 hour is the next selection/reference time, not a claim that all targets cover (c,t].
alignment.nominal_clock_window: (c, c+1 hour]; retained only as a reference for comparing actual measurement supports.
alignment.rain_predictor: P_completed_1h_at_cutoff: latest accepted native one-hour accumulation ending in (c-1 hour,c]; age is c minus actual accumulation end, strictly less than 60 minutes.
alignment.rain_target: Latest accepted native one-hour accumulation ending in (c,c+1 hour]. Preserve its actual start/end even when its start precedes c. Do not redistribute any accumulation.
alignment.temperature_wind: Predictors are latest QC report values at/before c with age at most 60 minutes. Targets use the same rule at t. DATE is the observation/report timestamp; instrument averaging-window bounds are not in the cache.
alignment.solar: Use the existing hourly grid value labelled c-1 hour as the predictor. Its assumed hour-start support is [c-1 hour,c]; the target is labelled c and assumed to cover [c,c+1 hour]. Cached POWER metadata confirms UTC and Wh/m2 but does not independently specify this interval anchor.
alignment.historical_availability_assumption: For retrospective selection only, assume a station report is usable at its reported observation/accumulation end, and a POWER hourly estimate at the assumed end of its hour. Publication latency is unknown and is not modeled.
alignment.limits: Station report/accumulation timing is checked directly. Solar timing remains conditional on the declared interval-anchor assumption. These mixed-support targets are not an exact one-hour-ahead forecast of four uniform clock-hour quantities.
alignment.missing_values: Leave unavailable or stale values missing; never zero-fill rainfall or carry a source indefinitely.

internal_split: Seeded random 70/30 development split; internal diagnostic only, not an independent chronological test.
